messages:
dana: quick q — thinking through UX for copying role templates between tenants. idea: 'Copy role preset' that preserves permissions but prompts for tenant-specific overrides (quota, region access). thoughts?
chris: want to avoid modal sprawl. prefer inline drawer with preview and diff.
maria: +1 drawer. need clear audit trace: who copied, original role id, timestamp. also surface conflicts (name collisions)
jay: conflict handling options: rename, merge permissions, or create new version. show sample diff and let admin toggle permissions ON/OFF before apply.
dana: good. how do we present scope differences? e.g., model routing policies not available in target tenant.
louisa: show disabled rows with reason tooltip: "unavailable in target tenant" and auto-suggest closest compatible setting.
chris: UX nit: default to safe (no automatic enabling sensitive permissions). keep checkboxes off; require explicit opt-in.
maria: backend note: need endpoint to simulate copy and return validation warnings. api proto:
```
POST /admin/role_presets/:id/simulate_copy
{ "target_tenant_id": "t-123" }
```
returns warnings: ["quota_exceed", "region_mismatch"]

jay: also include dry-run that returns resulting role manifest and audit metadata.
aud-it: audit-bot: role_copy simulated by maria at 2026-03-20T15:03:00Z
louisa: rollout plan: feature flag gated + telemetry event `role_preset_copy` with fields: initiator, source_preset, target_tenant, decision(rename|merge|version)
dana: ok action items: chris protos drawer UI, maria + backend simulate/dry-run endpoints, louisa telemetry & flag. i'll make a tiny design spec. anyone want to pair on the first pass?
chris: i can take prototyping this afternoon :white_check_mark:
maria: I'll start on API and test harness tomorrow.
jay: I'll wire the conflict merge logic in the service.
louisa: I'll add telemetry + flag toggle in console config.
dana: awesome. i'll post a short spec and link it here shortly :rocket:
